title: The Adventurer's Bag
story: Your hero can carry only a few things, and picking up the same item twice is silly.
goal: Write take(bag, item, limit=3): return a NEW list with the item added, unless it is already in the bag or the bag is full. Never change the original list.
hints: Two things stop you from adding. Which two?
bag + [item] makes a new list; bag.append(item) changes the old one.
socratic: What does list(bag) give you that bag itself does not?
What if the bag already holds the item AND is full?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what did you learn from “The Adventurer's Bag”?
